data.title: 菲亚梅塔 · 散场之后
data.description: 她从幕布后探身，把你叫到近处，问刚才的表演怎么样。听见夸奖，菲亚梅塔移开视线，耳尖却红了。
data.action: 掀幕靠近，回头等候回答
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Peering out from behind the heavy, velvet-draped theater curtains, Fiammetta beckons the viewer into the dimly lit, secret space of the wings. A warm, golden stage spotlight catches the faint blush on her cheeks as she turns to look at the viewer, with complex stage rigging, dangling light fixtures, and the blurred anticipation of the theater audience in the distant background.
